events.title: Soo Ra, Cole Cosby, Will Purpura, Tom Zappia, Neko White
events.description: Comedy Showcase featuring New York's funniest comedians!Cole Cosby is a comedian from Philadelphia (raised in South Jersey), now residing in New York. Cole’s interest in stand up comedy began in middle school from watching the performances of legends such as Dave Chappelle, Kevin Hart and the sitcoms of Jerry Seinfeld and Kevin James. Cole’s first time performing stand-up comedy came during his junior year of college at an open mic on Temple University’s campus. Since that day, and after graduation, Cole Cosby went on to rise in the Philadelphia comedy circuit, becoming a regular host (and feature act) at Helium and Punchline comedy clubs, and working with headliners such as Sam Jay, Josh Johnson, and Tony Rock. Cole Cosby has also opened on the road for comedy legends Sinbad, Caroline Rhea and Tammy Pescatelli. Since moving to New York City in 2023, Cole has passed at Stand Up NY, earned a residency at Broadway Comedy Club, and is on a mission to create his own Cosby legacy.Funny, smart, fresh, and magnetic, Neko White is a star. A comedian born and raised in Harlem, Neko has brought his unique perspective and sharp comedy from New York to international audiences. Beginning his career at just fourteen years old, the then high school freshman was sitting in class when a teacher asked, “Does anyone have a talent?” Something in Neko’s mind said, “Go tell jokes!“ He went up in front of his classmates and it worked. And, as they say, the rest is history. As a stand-up, Neko has been featured on Netflix’s "Pete Davidson Presents: The Best Friends," Cracked Comedy Club, TruTV’s "Laff Tracks," AXS TV’s "Gotham Comedy Live," STARZ’s "New York’s Funniest," and Kevin Hart’s LOL Network. He was named one of the "New Faces" in the Just For Laughs Festival, performed in Netflix is a Joke Festival, and won Carolines’ prestigious March Madness competition. Neko released a comedy album titled "Marscellus," then produced one of the most original filmed specials in recent memory with his self-released "Dark Out." Shot with no audience, a pitch-black background, and recorded with an old-fashioned microphone, Neko’s special received critical acclaim. One publication said "Dark Out" made Neko one of the “innovators changing comedy.” Neko also self-produced his first hour special, "Neko White: Introducing Me.” He was the subject of the award-winning documentary, “One Mic.”Neko is an accomplished television personality. He hosted Vice News’ popular series, "How To Be A Person" and has been a regular guest on MTV2’s "Hip Hop Hollywood Squares" and Comedy Central’s "Dark Humor." Neko made his film acting debut in the movie, "Midlife."

events.title: Beyond the Classic: Japanese YOUKOKU Relief Ceramics Exhibition by SUIYO @IPPIN Project
events.description:
Beyond the Classic: Japanese YOUKOKU Relief Ceramics Exhibition by SUIYO @IPPIN Project
[Introducing the Japanese YOUKOKU Relief Carving Ceramic Collection by Suiyo at IPPIN PROJECT]
Discover the captivating world of contemporary Japanese ceramics with the YOUKOKU Relief Carving Ceramic Collection by Suiyo, crafted in Aichi, Japan.
“As we’ve studied the classics, and with an eye on what will remain in the future, we will ‘go beyond’ images, genres, borders, and history, as well as our own past.”
— Daisuke Anayama
The collection showcases exquisite relief-carved ceramics featuring intricate motifs of auspicious animals, including cranes, turtles, and the animals of the Chinese Zodiac. Each piece brings together traditional Japanese craftsmanship and distinctive sculptural details, creating objects that are both meaningful and beautifully tactile.
Suiyo’s designs also draw inspiration from the classics of European art. In particular, Suiyo’s painter and carvener, Anayama Fumika’s designs reflects the decorative richness and intricate patterns of Austrian painter Gustav Klimt, creating a fascinating dialogue between Japanese ceramic traditions and European artistic heritage.
Experience a unique meeting of Eastern and Western cultural influences, where traditional craftsmanship goes beyond borders and is reimagined through a contemporary artistic lens.
Discover these beautifully crafted pieces at IPPIN PROJECT and bring a touch of Japanese artistry, symbolism, and timeless beauty to your collection.
*Artist: Daisuke Anayama: a ceramic artist and Fumika Anayama: a painter and carver.
Suiyo is a pottery brand produced by artists, Daisuke Anayama and Fumika Anayama based in Seto, Aichi. The brand concept “Beyond the Classic.” expresses their determination and hope to move forward to make their artworks a new classic in the modern age.

events.description:
Get It Right Music in association with BK One Productions is proud to present our late summer/early fall music documentary and horror film movies (yes, those two things go together, and yes, we ARE wondering why you are asking!). Watch fan favorites on our 16-foot wide LED video wall and enjoy the film in full concert sound!
A young Englishman in the Paris of 1899 becomes infatuated with Satine, a singer at the Moulin Rouge. However, she has been promised by the manager to a Duke in return for funding his next production. As the young lovers meet in secret, Satine’s wedding day draws closer, but she hides a fatal secret from both Christian and the Duke.
Event Info
Film: Halloween
Date: October 7th, 2026
Doors: 7:00pm
Screening: 7:30pm
RSVP: Free or strongly encourage guaranteed $20 two-drink included RSVP.
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn, New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The selection of music documentaries was curated by audience vote from our summer concert series and the horror movies came from out of our brains!
Seating for these screenings are limited to 150 people or so (with slightly more for the music docs so peeps can throw down appropriately.
Fans who purchase the 2 drink guaranteed RSVP will be guaranteed entry, natch! So you will save money at the bar, AND make sure you aren’t shut out!
This event is free with RSVP, ages 8 and up are welcome. There will be drink specials, all night, as well.
Limited seating (about 100-125 seats), tons of standing room. No strollers.
No outside beverages. There will be drink specials all night long from our courtyard bar.
While we do our best to gauge the number of RSVPs, entry is still on a first-come, first-served basis, so please arrive early! Once we hit capacity, we will only let people in on an in and out basis! Fans who purchase the 2 drink RSVP at check-out will be guaranteed entry!
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can get affordable drinks from the venue’s bar and order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.

events.title: Talking Heads – Stop Making Sense Film Screening
events.description:
REDUCE FOMO BY CLICKING HERE!
https://wl.eventim.us/event/talking-heads-stop-making-sense/704440?afflky=Getitrightthefirsttime
Get It Right Music in association with BK One Productions is proud to present our late summer/early fall music documentary and horror film movies (yes, those two things go together, and yes, we ARE wondering why you are asking!). Watch fan favorites on our 16-foot wide LED video wall and enjoy the film in full concert sound!
You have reached the ticketing page for Talking Heads – Stop Making Sense! This is gonna be one heck of a dance party under the stars.
This is the seminal 1984 American concert film featuring a live performance by the American rock band Talking Heads. The film was directed by Jonathan Demme and executive produced by Gary Kurfirst, the band’s longtime manager. The film was shot over four nights in December 1983 at Hollywood’s Pantages Theatre while Talking Heads were on tour promoting their fifth studio album, Speaking in Tongues (1983). Stop Making Sense includes performances of the early Talking Heads single “Psycho Killer” (1977), through to their most recent hit at the time, “Burning Down the House” (1983). It also includes songs from the solo career of frontman David Byrne and by Tom Tom Club, the side project of drummer Chris Frantz and bassist Tina Weymouth. Some have said it’s the greatest band document of all time.
Event Info
Film: Talking Heads – Stop Making Sense
Date: October 8th, 2026
Doors: 7pm
Screening Time: 7:30pm
RSVP: Free or strongly encourage guaranteed $20 two-drink included RSVP.
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn, New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The selection of music documentaries was curated by audience vote from our summer concert series and the horror movies came from out of our brains!
Seating for these screenings are limited to 150 people or so (with slightly more for the music docs so peeps can throw down appropriately.
Fans who purchase the 2 drink guaranteed RSVP will be guaranteed entry, natch! So you will save money at the bar, AND make sure you aren’t shut out!
This event is free with RSVP, ages 8 and up are welcome. There will be drink specials, all night, as well.
Limited seating (about 100-125 seats), tons of standing room. No strollers.
No outside beverages. There will be drink specials all night long from our courtyard bar.
While we do our best to gauge the number of RSVPs, entry is still on a first-come, first-served basis, so please arrive early! Once we hit capacity, we will only let people in on an in and out basis! Fans who purchase the 2 drink RSVP at check-out will be guaranteed entry!
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can get affordable drinks from the venue’s bar and order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.

events.title: Tom Zappia, Tina Zhu, Malachi Fox, Joe Mahoney, Shaunak Godkhindi, Natan Badalov, Derrell Meyers
events.description: FeaturingPeter LiuTom ZappiaMalachi FoxJoe MahoneyShaunak GodkhindiNatan BadalovDerrell MeyersOriginally from Buffalo, New York, Malachi Fox is a comedian, producer, and the founder of No Cent Comedy, an independent comedy showcase dedicated to creating unforgettable live comedy experiences while spotlighting both rising talent and established performers.As the creator of No Cent Comedy, Malachi has produced successful showcases in Buffalo, New York, and North Carolina, with the brand continuing to expand into new markets across the country. His productions are built on strong lineups, high-energy entertainment, and a commitment to creating opportunities for comedians while delivering memorable experiences for audiences.As a performer, Malachi has appeared on stages throughout the East Coast and West Coast, performing in numerous comedy clubs across New York City and beyond. He has also been featured in the Comedy Mob Festival and the Baltimore Comedy Festival, continuing to build a reputation as both a dynamic comic and a respected independent producer.Whether he’s behind the scenes producing shows or on stage behind the microphone, Malachi’s mission remains the same: to build community through comedy, create opportunities for comedians, and bring people together through unforgettable nights of laughter.Joe Mahoney is an NYC comic from Long Island who can play to many different crowds. His clever writing has earned him countless spots at the legendary Comic Strip Live and feature work on the road. He’s appeared on Adult Swim and Compound Media.Natan Badalov is a New York-based comedian and writer. He emigrated from Uzbekistan to the United States in the early 90’s. Since then, he has been featured on Adult Swim, New York Comedy Festival, Chosen Comedy Festival, Funnymmigrants Comedy Festival, Laughing Devil Comedy Festival, as well as many others.Natan created and wrote 'Park West’, an animated web series about his time in yeshiva. He also co-starred and wrote ‘Heartbreakers’, a web series about two roommates that help each other navigate their breakups and find love. His work has been featured on Channel 101 NY, American Jewish Film Festival, Alternative Film Festival, Flickfair Film Festival, Polish International Film Festival, and ANIMATOR - a Polish Animated Film Competition, Smiles Film Festival, and Animae Digital Film Festival.Natan’s first solo show ‘Connect The Dots’ was part of the The New York Comedy Festival and Rochester Fringe Festival, and he is currently touring it across the country. For more, you can follow him on socials @natanbadalov.

events.title: Subhah Agarwal, Eva Evans, Tom Zappia, Neko White, Jessica Levin
events.description: Prime-Time Comedy in Brooklyn!FEATURING SPECIAL GUEST COMEDIANS...Lineup BelowFeaturingSubhah AgarwalEva EvansTom ZappiaNeko WhiteJessica LevinSubhah Agarwal has brought an honesty to her comedy that will leave you saying "I didn't need to know that." Subhah has written for Netflix’s “Arsenio Hall” limited series, the "Plan B" movie on Hulu," and The Jim Jefferies Show"on Comedy Central, amongst others. You can also catch her jokes live at stand up comedy clubs across the country. If you don't want to leave your couch, you can see her late night debut on NBC's "A Little Late With Lilly Singh." She's also appeared on season three of HBO's "Westworld", "General Hospital," TruTv's sketch comedy "Friends of the People", and as herself on MTV2, Comedy Central, and Gotham Comedy Live.Hailing from Brooklyn and Jamaica, Eva Evans is a comedian that has been described as “the true definition of a hustler.” She recently showcased in the coveted Netflix Introducing showcase, recorded in Los Angeles May 2025. She’s been featured on Sway in the Morning at Caroline’s and The Wendy Williams Show, BET, and at the request of Senator Jessie Williams performed at the 2018 Women’s Empowerment Awards. Eva has performed in the Netflix is a Joke Festival, Laughing Skull Festival, Harlem Comedy Festival, and Manhattan Comedy Festival; and was the only female comedian to regularly perform in front of detainees at Riker's Island.Funny, smart, fresh, and magnetic, Neko White is a star. A comedian born and raised in Harlem, Neko has brought his unique perspective and sharp comedy from New York to international audiences. Beginning his career at just fourteen years old, the then high school freshman was sitting in class when a teacher asked, “Does anyone have a talent?” Something in Neko’s mind said, “Go tell jokes!“ He went up in front of his classmates and it worked. And, as they say, the rest is history. As a stand-up, Neko has been featured on Netflix’s "Pete Davidson Presents: The Best Friends," Cracked Comedy Club, TruTV’s "Laff Tracks," AXS TV’s "Gotham Comedy Live," STARZ’s "New York’s Funniest," and Kevin Hart’s LOL Network. He was named one of the "New Faces" in the Just For Laughs Festival, performed in Netflix is a Joke Festival, and won Carolines’ prestigious March Madness competition. Neko released a comedy album titled "Marscellus," then produced one of the most original filmed specials in recent memory with his self-released "Dark Out." Shot with no audience, a pitch-black background, and recorded with an old-fashioned microphone, Neko’s special received critical acclaim. One publication said "Dark Out" made Neko one of the “innovators changing comedy.” Neko also self-produced his first hour special, "Neko White: Introducing Me.” He was the subject of the award-winning documentary, “One Mic.”Neko is an accomplished television personality. He hosted Vice News’ popular series, "How To Be A Person" and has been a regular guest on MTV2’s "Hip Hop Hollywood Squares" and Comedy Central’s "Dark Humor." Neko made his film acting debut in the movie, "Midlife."Jessica Levin is an NYC comedian. The daughter of a sanitation worker, with longshoreman genes, she has a blue collar mentality with white color taste. When she's not in the clubs, she attempts to go to the gym but mostly ends up co-producing her shows "Tough Love Comedy" , "Fowl Mouth Comedy", and performing all around the city.
